sources.title: Universidad de Sta. Isabel: History
sources.note: Supports the facts listed here; historical events do not date the current mapped geometry.

text.en: Queen Isabella II's royal decree created the Escuela-Colegio de Sta. Isabel in November 1867.
The school formally opened on April 12, 1868.
A royal decree in 1872 elevated the college to a teacher-training school for women.
The first eleven students graduated in 1877.
